q: What is the carbon footprint of bleaching powder?
title: Bleaching powder carbon footprint
short: Bleaching powder is made by passing chlorine over slaked lime, a reaction that releases no CO2. Its footprint comes from the lime, whose kiln released process CO2 upstream, and from the electricity behind chlorine. On site, count only your fuel and power.
audience: Bleaching powder makers and water treatment buyers

ul: Quicklime or hydrated lime, carrying the kiln's process CO2.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills, fuel invoices and purchase invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so a per unit footprint can be traced back to the documents behind it. Estimates are labelled as estimates.
